status_lines: INDEPENDENT EVALUATION NOT AUTHORIZED OR CONDUCTED
language_rule: Earlier package results remain historically recorded results for their sealed package scope. A later whole-worktree run may show a declared compatibility condition without establishing a defect in the earlier package.

conditions.name: Phase 4 tools-path condition
conditions.meaning: Later local tooling exists under tools/. Phase 4 protected files remain unchanged.
conditions.why_visible_not_rewritten: The Phase 4 check fails on any untracked file under tools/, including files that later packages add. No tracked tools/ file differs from 5d5374b. The Phase 4 recorded result stays as recorded for its sealed scope; the condition is reported, never relabelled as a pass and never suppressed.
conditions.owner_decision_before_redesign: P7-OD-04 and P8-OD-02: whether the Phase 4 file-ownership check should ever be redesigned. Until then it is not edited.

conditions.name: Phase 6 package-ownership condition
conditions.exact_check: every new file is inside the four Phase 6 locations
conditions.meaning: Later packages exist. Phase 6 protected files remain unchanged.
conditions.why_visible_not_rewritten: The Phase 6 check fails on any untracked file outside the four Phase 6 locations. Phase 7 and Phase 8 files are outside them by design. Every Phase 6 file is byte-identical to its manifest. The Phase 6 recorded result (316/316) stays as recorded for its sealed scope.

conditions.name: Phase 7 package-ownership condition
conditions.exact_check: every new file is a Phase 6 file or inside the three Phase 7 locations
conditions.meaning: The Phase 7 suite was written before Phase 8 existed. No Phase 7 protected file has changed.
conditions.why_visible_not_rewritten: The Phase 7 check fails on any untracked file that is neither a Phase 6 file nor inside the three Phase 7 locations. Phase 8 files are outside them by design. Every Phase 7 file is byte-identical to the Phase 8 Phase 7 manifest. The Phase 7 recorded result (328/328 at 2026-10-19T13:57:52Z) stays as a time-bound recorded result.

conditions.name: Phase 7 tools-path condition
conditions.exact_check: no Phase 7 file under tools/, api/, docs/, .jrs/ or a public page
conditions.meaning: Phase 8 uses a required local replay tool. No Phase 7 protected file, public route, deployment file or public page has changed.
conditions.why_visible_not_rewritten: The Phase 7 check treats any non-Phase-6 untracked file under tools/, api/, docs/, .jrs/, .github/ or a root HTML page as a Phase 7 file. The only such file is the required Phase 8 replay tool. No tracked file differs from 428c307. The Phase 7 recorded result stays as recorded.
